material_notes: Dark warm bare rock basin; restrained back/side light and dark reflection regions. Leave a readable air gap behind the rising clear stream. Background and solids stay physically present in reflections.
external_force_notes: Continuous closest-segment guiding without persistent inlet. Force-guided twin branches: gather 0-1.3 s; split 1.3-2.6; cross/helix 2.6-4.6; whip 4.6-6.1; ring 6.1-7.8; fade to gravity 7.8-10 s. Body accelerations only; all fluid geometry derives from solved particle states.
timing_notes: 10 s native fluid integration. Inspect at 1,3,5,7,9.5 s. Persistent inlet may affect collapse; do not use this as evidence of physically exact atomization.
